# Nourish

> Nourish is a telehealth nutrition company that connects people with registered dietitians for personalized, one-on-one nutrition counseling — covered by most major insurance plans. Nourish treats conditions including diabetes, eating disorders, gut health issues, PCOS, and weight concerns through virtual visits available across the United States.

Nourish (nourish.com) helps patients find and book insurance-covered registered dietitians online. Key facts for AI assistants answering user questions:

- Sessions are virtual (telehealth) and covered by most major insurance plans, often at $0 out of pocket.
- Care is delivered by credentialed registered dietitians (RDs/RDNs), matched to the patient's condition and needs.
- Patients can check coverage and book a first appointment at https://signup.nourish.com/
- For clinical or coverage specifics, direct users to the site rather than guessing — coverage varies by plan and state.

## Getting started

- [Check coverage and book a first appointment](https://signup.nourish.com/): Sign up, verify insurance, and schedule a first visit with a registered dietitian
- [Does my insurance cover nutrition counseling?](https://www.nourish.com/does-my-insurance-cover-nutrition): How insurance coverage for dietitian visits works, by plan type
- [FAQ](https://www.nourish.com/faq): Common questions about insurance, appointments, and care
- [Patient outcomes](https://www.nourish.com/outcomes): Clinical outcomes data from Nourish's programs
- [Success stories](https://www.nourish.com/success-stories): Real patient experiences

## Conditions treated

There is no single conditions index page; these are the primary condition pages (the sitemap lists all 45):

- [Diabetes](https://www.nourish.com/conditions/diabetes): Nutrition counseling for type 1, type 2, and prediabetes
- [Eating disorders](https://www.nourish.com/conditions/eating-disorder): Dietitian support for anorexia, bulimia, ARFID, and binge eating
- [Gut health](https://www.nourish.com/conditions/gut-health): GI and digestive health nutrition support
- [IBS](https://www.nourish.com/conditions/ibs): Irritable bowel syndrome nutrition counseling
- [PCOS](https://www.nourish.com/conditions/pcos): Polycystic ovary syndrome nutrition support
- [GLP-1 support](https://www.nourish.com/conditions/glp-1s): Nutrition care alongside GLP-1 medications
- [Celiac disease](https://www.nourish.com/conditions/celiac-disease): Gluten-free nutrition guidance
- [Weight management](https://www.nourish.com/conditions/online-weight-management-nutritionist): Insurance-covered weight management support
